parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: ={{ $json.testEpicKey ? 'project = MAP AND key = ' + $json.testEpicKey : 'project = MAP AND issuetype = Epic AND status = Live' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'page', title: $json.pageTitle, status: $json.targetPageStatus, space: { key: $json.spaceKey }, ancestors: [{ id: $json.parentPageId }], body: { storage: { value: $json.storageBody, representation: 'storage' } }, metadata: { labels: [{ prefix: 'global', name: 'map-epic-' + $json.epicKey.toLowerCase() }, { prefix: 'global', name: 'map-tracking-active' }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ id: $json.existingPageId, type: 'page', title: $json.pageTitle, status: $json.targetPageStatus, version: { number: $json.existingPageVersion + 1 }, body: { storage: { value: $json.storageBody, representation: 'storage' } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify($('Build Payload').item.json.action === 'create' ? { key: 'fingerprint', value: $('Build Payload').item.json.fingerprint } : { key: 'fingerprint', value: $('Build Payload').item.json.fingerprint, version: { number: ($('Confluence Find Page').item.json.results[0]?.metadata?.properties?.fingerprint?.version?.number || 0) + 1 } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '[' + $('Build Payload').item.json.action.toUpperCase() + '] ' + $('Build Payload').item.json.epicKey + ' -> ' + $('Config').first().json.confluenceBaseUrl + '/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=' + ($('Save Fingerprint').item.json.content?.id || $('Build Payload').item.json.existingPageId) }) }}
